spans.s: vidvaj-jana (SITI), a body of learned men.
vidyā-bhoga (EI 18), same as vidy-ānubhoga and vidyā-dhana.
vidyā-dhana (HRS), explained as land assigned as a reward for learning; same as vidyā-bhoga and vidy-ānubhoga.
vidyādhara-toraṇa (SII 2), an ornamental arch probably depicting Vidyādharas; cf. makara-toraṇa.

Vidy-ādhikārin (EI 11, 25; HD), officer in charge of a school or of schools; the director of education. Cf. Ep. Ind., Vol. XI, p. 314; explained as ‘the chief court Pandit’ (Sarma, Reḍḍi Kingdoms, pp. 466-67).
vidy-ānubhoga (SITI), an endowment of land to a school for the encouragement of learning.
vidyā-sthāna (EI 2; SII 2; SITI), an educational institution for higher studies; a college.
